summary: John's 3rd great-grandfather; Irish-born, in Schuylkill County by 1857 and Plymouth by 1860.
bio:
Martin Murphy, born c.1835 in Ireland, had a child born in Schuylkill Co. in Feb 1857, was in Plymouth by 1860, and in Plymouth Twp. in 1870 and 1880. He died 8 May 1885.

In the 1870 census Martin Murphy was a miner in Plymouth Township, owning real estate worth $1,100 and personal property worth $200 ([R4-S1]). With him were Alice (35) and seven children: Mary 13, Patrick 12, Catherine 9, James 7, John 4, and one-month-old twins Martin and Thomas.
